title: feat(web): offer a split diff view alongside the stacked view
body:
The Files tab rendered patches with an inline stacked viewer only. It now uses a `DiffView` component with a Stacked / Split toggle remembered per signed-in user, falling back to stacked below 721px.

## What changed

- `lib/diff.ts` parses each file's unified patch into numbered hunks and lines and pairs lines for the split view. Files without a patch say why: renamed without changes, file mode changed, no text changes to show, or diff too large. Unknown hunk lines surface as "Could not read this diff." instead of wrong text.
- `lib/diff-layout.ts` keeps the choice in localStorage keyed per user, wrapped in try/catch, garbage falls back to stacked.
- `components/DiffView.tsx` renders both layouts, shows old → new path for renames, marks "No newline at end of file", collapses diffs over 500 lines behind an Expand button, and parses once per patch.
- Lines carry visually hidden added/removed text; the toggle is a radiogroup; the diff body is a region.
- The Files list shows +additions / −deletions from the hub response.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; `bun test apps/web` (parser tests for hunk headers with and without counts, the no-newline marker, split pairing, unknown lines; render tests for split rows, phone fallback and collapse).
- Browser pass on a local hub and portal: stacked and split both render on a one-line change, the split choice survives a reload, and a 30-file PR lists every file with counts and renders each in split.

Closes CL-XXXX
